name: Rover: Electro
desc: A mysterious Resonator with the power to absorb all sounds. Currently journeying to find their lost memories.

chara_info.info: A mysterious Resonator with the power to absorb all sounds. Currently journeying to find their lost memories.

voices.title: Idle: II
voices.content: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.

voices.title: Join Team: I
voices.content: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.

voices.title: Join Team: III
voices.content: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.

voices.title: Ascension: I
voices.content: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.

voices.title: Ascension: II
voices.content: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.

voices.title: Ascension: III
voices.content: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.

voices.title: Ascension: IV
voices.content: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.

voices.title: Ascension: V
voices.content: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

skill.name: Deterrence
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to {0} consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Parry Stance</color></size>
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> at the cost of STA. 
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes {1}% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to exit <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color>, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {3}</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Havoc</color>
In <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, use Dodge to consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Dodge: Flicker</color>, which can trigger successful <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Havoc</color></size>
Perform up to {4} consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting Stage {5} of this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {6}</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {7}</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skill.name: Myriad Omens' Mandate
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Overshock</color></size>
At max <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Stage {0}</color>.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> to grant Resonators in the team {1}% ATK Bonus for {2}s.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by holding down the button, consume <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> to enter <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Apex Resonance</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is unlocked, which consumes {4}% <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> per second:
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to launch up to {5} consecutive attacks:
- The first <SapTag=5>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=5}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- The next <SapTag=6>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=6}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The last <SapTag=7>{8}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=7}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
While on the ground, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and leaping into the air.
While airborne, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform up to {9} stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first <SapTag=9>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=9}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The next <SapTag=A>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=A}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last <SapTag=B>{12}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=B}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after landing to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>.
Each time <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> hits the target, <color=Highlight>Thunder Bane</color> is triggered, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target within range, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Electric Surge</color></size>
Rover can hold up to {13} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> is restored when <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Deterrence</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Thunderclap</color>, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Repel</color> deals damage.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Rage</color></size>
Rover can hold up to {14} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color>.
Entering <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> to the max limit.
<color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> is restored when <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> deals damage.
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Overshock</color></size>
At max <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color>.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> to grant Resonators in the team additional ATK.

<size=10></size>

While in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is unlocked. <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> is consumed each second in this state during combat.

skill.name: Rumbling Thunders
skill.desc:
The incoming Resonator gains <color=Highlight>Electro Core</color> for {0}s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with <color=Highlight>Electro Core</color> inflict Negative Statuses, their <color=Highlight>Electro Core</color> is consumed, and they gain {1}% All DMG Amplification for {2}s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color> state and clears all <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color>.

81001310.name: Rover: Electro
81001310.bg_description: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.

81011310.name: Rover: Electro
81011310.bg_description: Rover's uniform from a past life at Startorch Academy. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.

features:
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by holding down the button, enter <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color> and unlock <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color>.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, grant Resonators in the team ATK Bonus.
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> inflicts <color=Highlight>Electro Flare</color> on the target.
Outro Skill grants <color=Highlight>Electro Core</color> to the incoming Resonator. Triggering <color=Highlight>Electro Core</color> grants <color=Highlight>All DMG Amplification</color>.

130901.desc: When Rover: Electro is not in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, Intro Skill, Normal Attacks, and Resonance Skill grant <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> upon dealing damage.

130902.desc: At full <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> and grant all Resonators in the team ATK Bonus.

130903.desc: At full <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>, hold Resonance Skill to clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color> and unlock <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color>.

130904.desc:
While in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> is consumed each second during combat. <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> grants <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> upon dealing damage.
Casting Outro Skill to switch to another Resonator while in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color> clears all the <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color>.

130905.desc: Hold {0} to enter a <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, during which Rover gains immunity to interruption and DMG Reduction, and continuously consumes STA.

130906.desc:
Releasing {0} or depleting STA during the <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color>. If <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color> is cast upon receiving an incoming attack, Stagnate the target briefly and perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Dodge: Flicker</color> in the input direction. Taking a hit shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Dodge: Flicker</color> triggers a successful Dodge.
